# Restacking in a submodule recognizes the current checkout.
# https://github.com/abhinav/git-spice/issues/1474

as 'Test <test@example.com>'
at '2026-10-24T22:23:11Z'

# Create a submodule whose Git directory is absorbed into its parent.
mkdir sub
cd sub
git init -b main
git commit --allow-empty -m initial
cd ..
mkdir super
cd super
git init -b main
git -c protocol.file.allow=always submodule add ../sub sub
git commit -m 'Add submodule'
cd sub
gs repo init --trunk main
gs branch create feature -m feature

# An up-to-date branch must not be mistaken for another worktree.
gs branch restack
! stderr 'checked out in another worktree'
stderr 'feature: branch does not need to be restacked'

# Advance trunk and verify that restack actually rebases the feature.
gs trunk
git commit --allow-empty -m 'Advance trunk'
gs branch checkout feature
gs branch restack
! stderr 'checked out in another worktree'
stderr 'feature: restacked'
git merge-base --is-ancestor main feature
git log --format=%s main..feature
stdout '^feature$'
git branch --show-current
stdout '^feature$'
